title: Daniele Warin — General Osteopathic Council decision (2026-04-10)
text:
Undertaking offered to the Investigating / Professional Conduct Committee of the
General Osteopathic Council
(Interim order hearing - 10 April 2026, 09:30)

I, Daniele Warin, a registered osteopath (Registration number:5936) voluntarily provide
the following undertaking to the Investigating / Professional Conduct Committee of the
General Osteopathic Council (“GOsC”) in connection with the allegations currently
under investigation in Case No. 26-007/5936.

1. Nature of Undertaking
I acknowledge that this undertaking constitutes a solemn written promise to the
Investigating / Professional Conduct Committee regarding my practice and conduct
pending the final determination of the allegations.
2. Restriction on Practice
I undertake that, with immediate effect, I will not undertake any osteopathic
assessment, treatment, or clinical care of patients under the age of 16 years.
This restriction is offered in light of the nature of the allegations, which concern the
alleged exposure of a child to an indecent image, and is intended to ensure that I do not
have any clinical contact with patients under the age of 16, thereby addressing any
potential or perceived risk to that patient group.

3. Scope of Application
This restriction applies to all settings in which I practise, including but not limited to
private practice, employed roles, locum work, and any other professional or therapeutic
context.
4. Notification to Third Parties
I undertake to inform any current or prospective employer, engager, contractor, or
organisation with whom I practise or intend to practise of:
(a) the existence and terms of this undertaking; and
(b) the fact that it arises from allegations currently under investigation by the
GOsC,
prior to commencing or continuing such work.
5. Evidence of Notification

I undertake, upon request, to provide the GOsC with evidence that such notification has
been made and that any relevant third party is aware of and content with the
arrangements in place.
6. Monitoring and Compliance
I undertake to provide such information and documentation as the GOsC may
reasonably require from time to time to demonstrate compliance with this undertaking.
7. Notification of Inability to Comply
I undertake to notify the GOsC immediately if I become aware that I may not be able to
comply with any part of this undertaking.
8. Duration
I confirm that these restrictions shall remain in place until the final determination of the
allegations by a GOsC fitness to practise committee, or until such earlier date as they
are varied or revoked by the GOsC.
9. Publication and Disclosure
I consent to:
(a) the publication of this undertaking on the GOsC website; and
(b) its disclosure by the GOsC to any person or organisation where it considers it
appropriate in the public interest.
10. Acknowledgement of Consequences
I acknowledge that failure to comply with this undertaking may amount to unacceptable
professional conduct and may result in further regulatory action.
11. Basis and Purpose of Undertaking
This undertaking is provided on a voluntary and precautionary basis to address any
potential or perceived risk arising from the nature of the allegations, pending the
outcome of the GOsC investigation.
It is offered without any admission of any wrongdoing, liability, misconduct or
impairment and without prejudice to my position that the allegation is denied.
Signed: _______
____________________

Name: Daniele Warin

Date: 09th April 2026
court: General Osteopathic Council — Professional Conduct / Health Committee
